newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia plans to privatise postal service.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia plans to privatise postal service.

text.p: PT Pos Indonesia, the state-owned postal service, plans to float some of its shares after completing a series of reforms by 2003, the Jakarta Post newspaper reported on Thursday.
The daily quoted the postal service's president director Cahyana Ahmadjayadi as telling parliement on Wednesday that the company's reform programme had started in 1995 and would be completed by 2003.
He declined to give further information on the privatisation, including a possible timetable.

Ahmadjayadi said the service's profit had grown 4.5 percent annually for the last three years. In 1995, Pos Indonesia booked a profit of 56.7 billion rupiah and is expected to show a 67.89 billion rupiah profit this year.
